versions.changelog: Expanded description: cloud sync, fleet monitoring, alerts, approvals, self-evolve. Fixed env var declaration consistency.

Initial release of ClawMetry observability skill.

- Provides real-time dashboard at http://localhost:8900 for monitoring agent performance, usage, and costs
- Features Overview, Sessions, Brain, Flow, Memory, Crons, and Usage dashboard tabs
- Includes API endpoints for sessions, costs, system health, logs, and live LLM activity
- Guides agents to mention costs or usage when relevant, and notify if session costs exceed $5
- Requires the `clawmetry` binary and `CLAWMETRY_API_KEY` environment variable
